status.idea: Concept or design note only; no install target.
status.prototype: Works in demos; APIs unstable; may lack tests.
status.experimental: Usable with caveats; breaking changes likely.
status.canary: Default for active integration branches; dogfooded internally.
status.deprecated: Still present; do not start new work here.
status.reference: Illustrative or historical; not a product surface.

execution.shadow: Emits side-channel telemetry only; no user-visible effect.
execution.log_only: Records decisions; does not act on them.
execution.canary: Partial live path; gated or opt-in.

invariants: Desired intent and runtime-safe plan remain distinguishable.
invalidators: Runtime executes an uncompiled intent while claiming compiled-plan semantics.

invariants: Decision space is explicit and bounded before typed scoring/readout.
Receipt identifies enough context to audit the decision.
invalidators: Free-form generation substitutes for the bounded decision while retaining the same semantic label.

invariants: Verification failure falls open rather than silently inventing evidence.
invalidators: Verification failure is accepted as valid compressed evidence.

invariants: Cost/token/latency claims come from measurement evidence rather than architecture inference.
invalidators: Economic metrics are reconstructed solely from model/provider assumptions.

invariants: Original observation remains exactly recallable through the stable handle.
Large context remains externally addressable rather than being irreversibly discarded.
The coding-agent runtime remains authoritative for execution.
invalidators: RLM/context-spill implementation is removed from OMP.
The mechanism moves to another authoritative runtime without the registry being updated.
abstain_if: selected implementation ref cannot provide either architecture documentation or source evidence.

invariants: Observed execution remains distinguishable from intended execution.
Missing trace evidence is represented as missing, not synthesized.
invalidators: Observed topology is inferred without trace/runtime evidence and presented as fact.
